title: Final Energy Levels
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide all four final energy levels E_1, E_2, E_3, and E_0 correctly.

title: Use of Eigenstates
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the eigenstates chi_{SM_S} for the total spin S and its z-component M_S.

title: Application of S^2
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the relation S^2 = (s_1 + s_2)^2 to derive the energy levels.

title: Correct Spin Coupling
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the coupling of spins and the distinction between triplet and singlet states.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all terms are consistent in units throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or missing factors in the energy expressions.

title: Derivation Clarity
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present clear and logical steps in the derivation of the energy levels.
